what: Append-only record of every evaluation against the final holdout window. Committed on purpose: it is what makes 'the holdout was read exactly once' auditable rather than merely asserted. A 'smoke' read was a run of the evaluation code itself (COPILOT_HOLDOUT_SMOKE=1), made against an already-frozen model and incapable of informing a hyperparameter or the abstention threshold. Only 'authoritative' reads produce a headline number.
